MISSING_APPROVAL.recommended_action: Obtain formal manager approval on the Jira change request before deploying to production.
MISSING_APPROVAL.verification_method: Verify Jira change request has decision APPROVED.

MISSING_CHANGE_RECORD.recommended_action: Create a corresponding Jira change request record and link it to the pull request.
MISSING_CHANGE_RECORD.required_evidence: Jira issue key link in the commits/PR
MISSING_CHANGE_RECORD.verification_method: Verify Jira change request exists and is linked.

OTHER.recommended_action: Investigate change request details and resolve missing information.

FAILED_TEST.recommended_action: Investigate the failed CI pipeline, correct the failure, rerun the required test workflow, and ensure the successful test completes before production deployment.
FAILED_TEST.verification_method: Re-evaluate CM-002 using the latest CURRENT evidence.

TEST_AFTER_DEPLOYMENT.recommended_action: Configure the CI/CD pipeline or branch protection rules to enforce testing execution and approval prior to production release.
TEST_AFTER_DEPLOYMENT.required_evidence: CI test run completed before deployment
TEST_AFTER_DEPLOYMENT.verification_method: Verify testing timestamp is earlier than deployment timestamp.

MISSING_EVIDENCE.recommended_action: Execute the required testing workflow and ensure the execution logs are published.
MISSING_EVIDENCE.verification_method: Verify presence of test log evidence.

OTHER.recommended_action: Verify testing was executed on the deployment commit.
OTHER.verification_method: Verify testing was completed on deployment commit.

REVIEW_DISMISSED.recommended_action: Submit code changes for review, address reviews, and obtain necessary approval before merging.
REVIEW_DISMISSED.verification_method: Verify active GitHub review has approved status.

APPROVAL_REVOKED.recommended_action: Address feedback from peer review, resolve conflicts, and obtain a fresh review approval.

MISSING_APPROVAL.recommended_action: Request code review from an authorized peer reviewer and obtain approval before merging.

UNAUTHORIZED_DEPLOYMENT.recommended_action: Ensure that the change request requester is segregated from the approver and deployer user roles.
UNAUTHORIZED_DEPLOYMENT.verification_method: Verify SOD audit log proves user role separation.

OTHER.recommended_action: Verify that user segregation rules are respected.

COMMIT_DRIFT.recommended_action: Verify that the deployed commit matches the approved commit. Avoid cherry-picking or manual alterations post-approval.
COMMIT_DRIFT.required_evidence: Matching deployment and PR commit SHA
COMMIT_DRIFT.verification_method: Verify deployment commit matches approved PR commit.

TRACEABILITY_FAILURE.recommended_action: Ensure the deployment is linked to an authorized GitHub pull request and Jira issue.

UNAUTHORIZED_DEPLOYMENT.recommended_action: Deploy using authorized pipelines with linked traceability.
